1.en: Woe waylun an expression implying chastisement to every backbiter who is a slanderer frequently engaging in backbiting and slander that is to say defamation — this was revealed regarding those who slandered the Prophet s and the believers the likes of Umayya b. Khalaf al-Walīd b. al-Mughīra and others —
1.ar: ﴿ويْل﴾ كَلِمَة عَذاب أوْ وادٍ فِي جَهَنَّم ﴿لِكُلِّ هُمَزَة لُمَزَة﴾ أيْ كَثِير الهَمْز واللَّمْز، أيْ الغِيبَة نَزَلَتْ فِيمَن كانَ يَغْتاب النَّبِيّ ﷺ والمُؤْمِنِينَ كَأُمَيَّة بْن خَلَف والوَلِيد بْن المُغِيرَة وغَيْرهما

2.en: who amasses read jama‘a or jamma‘a wealth and counts it over keeping count of it and stores it aside as a provision against the unforeseeable calamities of time.
2.ar: ﴿الَّذِي جَمَعَ﴾ بِالتَّخْفِيفِ والتَّشْدِيد ﴿مالًا وعَدَّدَهُ﴾ أحْصاهُ وجَعَلَهُ عُدَّة لِحَوادِث الدَّهْر

3.en: He thinks in his ignorance that his wealth will make him immortal never to die.
3.ar: ﴿يَحْسَب﴾ لِجَهْلِهِ ﴿أنَّ ماله أخْلَدَهُ﴾ جَعَلَهُ خالِدًا لا يَمُوت

4.en: Nay! — a repudiation — He will surely be flung la-yunbadhanna is the response to an omitted oath that is he will be hurled down into the Crusher that crushes everything that is thrown into it.
4.ar: ﴿كَلّا﴾ رَدْع ﴿لَيُنَبَذَنَّ﴾ جَواب قَسَم مَحْذُوف، أيْ لَيُطْرَحَنَّ ﴿فِي الحُطَمَة﴾ الَّتِي تُحَطِّم كُلّ ما أُلْقِيَ فِيها

5.en: And what will show you what will make known to you what the Crusher is?

6.en: It is the fire of God kindled set ablaze

7.en: which peers over the hearts to burn them — the pain of which is much more severe than any other because of the delicate nature of the heart.
7.ar: ﴿الَّتِي تَطَّلِع﴾ تُشْرِف ﴿عَلى الأَفْئِدَة﴾ القُلُوب فَتُحْرِقها وأَلَمها أشَدّ مِن ألَم غَيْرها لِلُطْفِها

8.en: Lo! it will be closed in mu’sada or mūsada on them ‘alayhim ‘on them’ the plural pronoun takes into account the plural import of kull ‘every’
8.ar: ﴿إنَّها عَلَيْهِمْ﴾ جَمَعَ الضَّمِير رِعايَة لِمَعْنى كُلّ ﴿مُؤْصَدَة﴾ بِالهَمْزِ وبِالواوِ بَدَله، مُطْبَقَة

9.en: in outstretched mumaddadatin is an adjective qualifying the preceding noun ‘amadin columns read ‘umudin or ‘amadin and will therefore be inside the columns.
9.ar: ﴿فِي عَمَد﴾ بِضَمِّ الحَرْفَيْنِ وبِفَتْحِهِما ﴿مُمَدَّدَة﴾ صِفَة لِما قَبْله فَتَكُون النّار داخِل العَمَد
